description: This file defines the 'ParameterRow' class, which represents a row of parameters in the UI of the RomRaider ECU logging tool. It encapsulates a 'LoggerData' object and manages its selection state.

classes.name: ParameterRow
classes.description: Final class representing a row of parameters in the UI, wrapping around 'LoggerData' and managing selection state.

methods.name: ParameterRow
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ParameterRow with a LoggerData object, ensuring it is not null.

methods.name: getLoggerData
methods.description: Returns the LoggerData associated with this ParameterRow.

methods.name: isSelected
methods.description: Returns whether the parameter row is currently selected.

methods.name: setSelected
methods.description: Sets the selection state of the parameter row and updates the LoggerData accordingly.
